question: Should both OpenGrep security workflows permanently fail installation after 300 seconds?
rationale: A fixed fail-closed deadline trades bounded CI execution against possible false failures on slow runners, and repository tests cannot determine the acceptable operational cutoff.

options.title: Approve 300 seconds
options.body: Keep the current shared deadline because it provides a generous bound while ensuring security scans cannot stall indefinitely.

options.title: Retune the deadline
options.body: Choose a different owner-approved cutoff based on observed installation duration and runner variability before merging.

recommendation.title: Approve 300 seconds
recommendation.body: Keep the current shared deadline because it provides a generous bound while ensuring security scans cannot stall indefinitely.
